name: create_apex_class

name: create_lwc_component
title: Create LWC Component Tool
description: Creates Lightning Web Component bundles with HTML, JS, CSS, meta.xml, and optional Apex controller

name: create_aura_component
title: Create Aura Component Tool
description: Creates Aura component bundles with .cmp, controller, helper, and optional design/renderer files

name: create_visualforce_page
title: Create Visualforce Page Tool
description: Creates Visualforce pages with optional custom Apex controllers and meta.xml

name: write_file
title: Write File Tool
description: Writes content to any file path - use for metadata, configs, package.xml, docs, or any non-component file

name: edit_file
title: Edit File Tool
description: Edits existing files using replace (full overwrite) or patch (targeted changes) mode

name: read_file
title: Read File Tool
description: Reads the contents of existing files - use before editing to understand current state

name: list_files
title: List Files Tool
description: Lists all files and directories in a given path - use to understand project structure
